scenarios.title: A｜要求安静的房间
scenarios.setting: 在“提出房间偏好”情景中，你将练习如何用英语处理“要求安静的房间”。

turns.text: Everything looks good. Your room is almost ready.

turns.prompt: 你想表达希望安排安静房间的偏好，会怎么说？

choices.text: Could I have a quiet room, if possible?

feedback.naturalExpression: Could I have a quiet room, if possible?
feedback.explanation: “Could I / we …?”礼貌提出自己的需求或征求许可；这里不是在说过去的能力。

choices.text: Do you have a quiet room available?

feedback.naturalExpression: Do you have a quiet room available?
feedback.explanation: “available”指可获得或可使用的；询问服务时常指有没有余位。

choices.text: I’d prefer a quiet room, if possible.

feedback.naturalExpression: I’d prefer a quiet room, if possible.
feedback.explanation: 把选择说成自己的偏好，可以表明立场，而不必否定另一种选择。

choices.text: Can you give me a quieter room?

feedback.assessment: 可以理解，但还可以更自然
feedback.naturalExpression: Could I have a quiet room, if possible?
feedback.explanation: “quieter”带有与另一间房比较的意思；若只是初次提出偏好，“a quiet room”就足够。

choices.text: Can I have a silence room?

feedback.naturalExpression: Could I have a quiet room, if possible?
feedback.explanation: “silence”是名词，修饰房间应使用形容词“quiet”；“a quiet room”就是安静的房间。

turns.text: Of course. Let me see what we have available.

turns.prompt: 你想回应对方的帮助或安排，表达谢意，会怎么说？

choices.text: I’d really appreciate somewhere away from the street.

feedback.naturalExpression: I’d really appreciate somewhere away from the street.
feedback.explanation: “away from”表示远离，可用于说明想避开的噪音源或希望的位置。

choices.text: If possible, I’d prefer a room that doesn’t face the street.

feedback.naturalExpression: If possible, I’d prefer a room that doesn’t face the street.
feedback.explanation: 把选择说成自己的偏好，可以表明立场，而不必否定另一种选择。

choices.text: Is there a room on the quieter side of the hotel?

feedback.naturalExpression: Is there a room on the quieter side of the hotel?
feedback.explanation: 先确认有没有所需的物品、服务或安排，为后面的选择提供依据。

choices.text: I don’t want a room near the street because it’s too noisy.

feedback.assessment: 可以理解，但还可以更自然
feedback.naturalExpression: I’d really appreciate somewhere away from the street.
feedback.explanation: 这句语法自然，也说明了理由；改成表达自己希望的位置，会更突出偏好而不是只否定临街房。

choices.text: I don’t want my room face the street.

feedback.naturalExpression: I’d really appreciate somewhere away from the street.
feedback.explanation: “want”后若用“房间朝向街道”这一结构，需要“my room to face …”；也可正面说明想远离街道。

turns.text: We have a room facing the courtyard. It’s usually much quieter.

turns.prompt: 你想确认推荐的安静房间是否符合原来的房型需求，会怎么说？

choices.text: That sounds perfect. Is it the same room type I booked?

feedback.naturalExpression: That sounds perfect. Is it the same room type I booked?
feedback.explanation: “room type”指房型，换房时可据此确认规格是否保持一致。

choices.text: A courtyard-facing room would be great. Is it still a double room?

feedback.naturalExpression: A courtyard-facing room would be great. Is it still a double room?
feedback.explanation: “would be great”把选择说成自己乐于接受的安排，比命令对方照办更柔和。

choices.text: That sounds good. Would there be any extra charge?

feedback.naturalExpression: That sounds good. Would there be any extra charge?
feedback.explanation: “extra charge”指额外收费，询问的是原价之外是否还要付钱。

choices.text: That room sounds more quiet.

feedback.assessment: 可以理解，但还可以更自然
feedback.naturalExpression: That sounds perfect. Is it the same room type I booked?
feedback.explanation: “more quiet”并非不能用，但“quieter”更简洁常见；两种都能表达更安静。

choices.text: Is that room need extra money?

feedback.naturalExpression: That sounds perfect. Is it the same room type I booked?
feedback.explanation: 疑问句可说“Does that room cost extra?”；“is … need”把两种结构混在一起了。

turns.text: It’s the same room type, and there’s no extra charge.

turns.prompt: 你想说出自己的偏好或顾虑，会怎么表达？

choices.text: Great. I’d prefer that room, please.

feedback.naturalExpression: Great. I’d prefer that room, please.
feedback.explanation: 把选择说成自己的偏好，可以表明立场，而不必否定另一种选择。

choices.text: Perfect. I’ll take that one.

feedback.naturalExpression: Perfect. I’ll take that one.
feedback.explanation: “will”在这里交代接下来的决定或行动，让对方知道自己会怎样继续。

choices.text: That works for me. Thank you.

feedback.naturalExpression: That works for me. Thank you.
feedback.explanation: 用简短感谢接住对方的帮助或答复，表示已经收到这份好意。

turns.text: Certainly. I’ll assign you the courtyard-facing room.

scenarios.title: B｜要求高楼层
scenarios.setting: 在“提出房间偏好”情景中，你将练习如何用英语处理“要求高楼层”。

turns.text: I’ve found your reservation. We’ll have your key card ready in just a moment.

turns.prompt: 你想询问能否安排较高楼层，会怎么说？

choices.text: Could I have a room on a higher floor, if possible?

feedback.naturalExpression: Could I have a room on a higher floor, if possible?
feedback.explanation: “Could I / we …?”礼貌提出自己的需求或征求许可；这里不是在说过去的能力。

choices.text: Do you have any rooms available on a high floor?

feedback.naturalExpression: Do you have any rooms available on a high floor?
feedback.explanation: “available”指可获得或可使用的；询问服务时常指有没有余位。

choices.text: I’d prefer a room on one of the higher floors.

feedback.naturalExpression: I’d prefer a room on one of the higher floors.
feedback.explanation: 把选择说成自己的偏好，可以表明立场，而不必否定另一种选择。

choices.text: Can you put me on a higher floor?

feedback.naturalExpression: Can you put me on a higher floor?
feedback.explanation: “Can you …?”直接请对方帮忙，是常见口语请求；使用“can”本身并不等于不礼貌。

choices.text: Can you give me a high floor room?

feedback.assessment: 可以理解，但还可以更自然
feedback.naturalExpression: Could I have a room on a higher floor, if possible?
feedback.explanation: 可以理解高楼层需求；更常说“a room on a higher floor”，用“on”连接房间和楼层。

turns.text: Let me check. We have rooms available on the third and tenth floors.

turns.prompt: 你想向前台说明自己倾向的楼层，会怎么说？

choices.text: Could I have the one on the tenth floor?

feedback.naturalExpression: Could I have the one on the tenth floor?
feedback.explanation: “the one”指代前面已谈到的人或物；补充位置或特征，就能区分具体是哪一个。

choices.text: I’d prefer the tenth floor, please.

feedback.naturalExpression: I’d prefer the tenth floor, please.
feedback.explanation: 把选择说成自己的偏好，可以表明立场，而不必否定另一种选择。

choices.text: The tenth floor would be great.

feedback.naturalExpression: The tenth floor would be great.
feedback.explanation: “would be great”把选择说成自己乐于接受的安排，比命令对方照办更柔和。

choices.text: Can I choose tenth floor?

feedback.assessment: 可以理解，但还可以更自然
feedback.naturalExpression: Could I have the one on the tenth floor?
feedback.explanation: 具体楼层需要“the tenth floor”；酒店安排房间时，说想要那层的房间更明确。

choices.text: I want live on tenth floor.

feedback.naturalExpression: Could I have the one on the tenth floor?
feedback.explanation: “want”后接动作时需要“to + 动词原形”；提出服务需求也可以用“I’d like to …”，既补全结构，也更委婉。

turns.text: Certainly. The room on the tenth floor is available.

turns.prompt: 你想确认换到高楼层后的房型或费用，会怎么说？

choices.text: Great. Is it the same room type as my original booking?

feedback.naturalExpression: Great. Is it the same room type as my original booking?
feedback.explanation: “booking”指预订，酒店、交通和活动中都常用。

choices.text: Perfect. There’s no extra charge, right?

feedback.naturalExpression: Perfect. There’s no extra charge, right?
feedback.explanation: “extra charge”指额外收费，询问的是原价之外是否还要付钱。

choices.text: Great. Does everything else in my reservation stay the same?

feedback.naturalExpression: Great. Does everything else in my reservation stay the same?
feedback.explanation: “reservation”指预订，指已经或准备安排的预约记录。

choices.text: The price doesn’t change, yes?

feedback.assessment: 可以理解，但还可以更自然
feedback.naturalExpression: Great. Is it the same room type as my original booking?
feedback.explanation: 可以核对费用是否不变；句尾更常用“right?”，而不是直接加“yes?”。

turns.text: That’s right. There’s no difference in price.

turns.prompt: 关于「提出房间偏好」，你想说明自己接下来能做什么或打算怎么做，会怎么说？

choices.text: Perfect. I’ll take the room on the tenth floor.

feedback.naturalExpression: Perfect. I’ll take the room on the tenth floor.
feedback.explanation: “will”在这里交代接下来的决定或行动，让对方知道自己会怎样继续。

choices.text: Great, that works for me. Thank you.

feedback.naturalExpression: Great, that works for me. Thank you.
feedback.explanation: 用简短感谢接住对方的帮助或答复，表示已经收到这份好意。

choices.text: Thanks, I appreciate it.

feedback.naturalExpression: Thanks, I appreciate it.
feedback.explanation: “I appreciate”表达对帮助、坦诚或付出的感谢，后面点明感谢对象更具体。

turns.text: You’re welcome. I’ll assign that room to you.

scenarios.title: C｜要求远离电梯
scenarios.setting: 在“提出房间偏好”情景中，你将练习如何用英语处理“要求远离电梯”。

turns.text: All right. I have a room ready for you on the eighth floor.

turns.prompt: 你想提出希望房间远离电梯，会怎么说？

choices.text: Would it be possible to have a room away from the elevator?

feedback.naturalExpression: Would it be possible to have a room away from the elevator?
feedback.explanation: “away from”表示远离，可用于说明想避开的噪音源或希望的位置。

choices.text: Could I get a room farther away from the elevator?

feedback.naturalExpression: Could I get a room farther away from the elevator?
feedback.explanation: “away from”表示远离，可用于说明想避开的噪音源或希望的位置。

choices.text: I’d prefer not to be too close to the elevator.

feedback.naturalExpression: I’d prefer not to be too close to the elevator.
feedback.explanation: 把选择说成自己的偏好，可以表明立场，而不必否定另一种选择。

choices.text: Is there a room away from the elevators?

feedback.naturalExpression: Is there a room away from the elevators?
feedback.explanation: “away from”表示远离，可用于说明想避开的噪音源或希望的位置。

choices.text: I don’t want near the elevator.

feedback.naturalExpression: Would it be possible to have a room away from the elevator?
feedback.explanation: “want”后缺少具体动作或对象；可以说“I don’t want a room near the elevator”。

turns.text: Of course. Is noise your main concern?

turns.prompt: 你想说出自己的偏好或顾虑，会怎么表达？

choices.text: Yes, I’m a light sleeper, so I’d prefer somewhere quiet.

feedback.naturalExpression: Yes, I’m a light sleeper, so I’d prefer somewhere quiet.
feedback.explanation: 把选择说成自己的偏好，可以表明立场，而不必否定另一种选择。

choices.text: Yes. I’m worried about people coming and going at night.

feedback.naturalExpression: Yes. I’m worried about people coming and going at night.
feedback.explanation: 明确说出担心之处，方便对方针对顾虑解释；没有把担心直接说成已发生的事实。

choices.text: Yes, I’d just prefer a quieter room.

feedback.naturalExpression: Yes, I’d just prefer a quieter room.
feedback.explanation: “I’d just prefer”轻轻强调个人偏好，适合在已有方案中提出调整。

choices.text: Yes, I can’t sleep good with noise.

feedback.naturalExpression: Yes, I’m a light sleeper, so I’d prefer somewhere quiet.
feedback.explanation: 修饰睡得怎样用副词“well”，不是“good”；“a light sleeper”还能简洁说明自己容易被声音吵醒。

choices.text: Yes, elevator has too much noise.

feedback.naturalExpression: Yes, I’m a light sleeper, so I’d prefer somewhere quiet.
feedback.explanation: “elevator”前需要限定词；说自己受声音影响或希望远离电梯，比笼统断言电梯太吵更容易安排。

turns.text: I understand. We have a room at the end of the hallway, away from the elevators.

turns.prompt: 你想进一步确认新房间与电梯的距离，会怎么说？

choices.text: That sounds good. How far is it from the elevator?

feedback.naturalExpression: That sounds good. How far is it from the elevator?
feedback.explanation: “how far”问距离，适合判断地点之间是否方便到达。

choices.text: A room at the end of the hallway would be fine.

feedback.naturalExpression: A room at the end of the hallway would be fine.
feedback.explanation: “at the end of”说明位于末端，可用于走廊尽头等具体位置。

choices.text: Great. Is it still the same room type?

feedback.naturalExpression: Great. Is it still the same room type?
feedback.explanation: “room type”指房型，换房时可据此确认规格是否保持一致。

choices.text: That’s okay. Is it very far to walk?

feedback.assessment: 可以理解，但还可以更自然
feedback.naturalExpression: That sounds good. How far is it from the elevator?
feedback.explanation: 这句自然地问步行是否很远；若关心的是房间离电梯多远，应明确参照点。

turns.text: It’s about a minute’s walk from the elevators, and it’s the same room type you booked.

turns.prompt: 关于「提出房间偏好」，你想说明自己接下来能做什么或打算怎么做，会怎么说？

choices.text: That’s perfect. I’ll take that room, please.

feedback.naturalExpression: That’s perfect. I’ll take that room, please.
feedback.explanation: “will”在这里交代接下来的决定或行动，让对方知道自己会怎样继续。

choices.text: That works for me. Thank you.

feedback.naturalExpression: That works for me. Thank you.
feedback.explanation: 用简短感谢接住对方的帮助或答复，表示已经收到这份好意。

choices.text: Great. I’d prefer that one.

feedback.naturalExpression: Great. I’d prefer that one.
feedback.explanation: 把选择说成自己的偏好，可以表明立场，而不必否定另一种选择。

turns.text: Certainly. I’ll change the room assignment for you.

scenarios.title: D｜要求连通房
scenarios.setting: 在“提出房间偏好”情景中，你将练习如何用英语处理“要求连通房”。

turns.text: I found both reservations. You have two double rooms for three nights.

turns.prompt: 你想询问是否可以安排连通房，会怎么说？

choices.text: Yes. Do you have any connecting rooms available?

feedback.naturalExpression: Yes. Do you have any connecting rooms available?
feedback.explanation: “available”指可获得或可使用的；询问服务时常指有没有余位。

choices.text: Would it be possible to get connecting rooms?

feedback.naturalExpression: Would it be possible to get connecting rooms?
feedback.explanation: 先问是否有可能安排，适合需要对方查看余位或规则的请求，语气比直接要求更柔和。

choices.text: Could we have two rooms that connect to each other?

feedback.naturalExpression: Could we have two rooms that connect to each other?
feedback.explanation: “connect to”表示连接到某个网络或设备，后面点明对象就能明确要连哪一个。

choices.text: We’d like connecting rooms, if possible.

feedback.naturalExpression: We’d like connecting rooms, if possible.
feedback.explanation: “would like”清楚表达需求，语气比直接说“want”更委婉，适合提出请求或表达偏好。

choices.text: Can our two rooms connect together?

feedback.assessment: 可以理解，但还可以更自然
feedback.naturalExpression: Yes. Do you have any connecting rooms available?
feedback.explanation: 酒店连通房是固定设施，不是把两间房临时接起来；直接问“connecting rooms”更准确。

turns.text: Let me check. We don’t have any connecting rooms available on the floor you’re currently assigned to.

turns.prompt: 你想请前台查询其他楼层的连通房，会怎么说？

choices.text: Are there connecting rooms available on another floor?

feedback.naturalExpression: Are there connecting rooms available on another floor?
feedback.explanation: “available”指可获得或可使用的；询问服务时常指有没有余位。

choices.text: Could you check another floor for us?

feedback.naturalExpression: Could you check another floor for us?
feedback.explanation: “Could you …?”把希望对方做的动作写进问句，是常见的委婉请求。

choices.text: Is there any way we could switch to connecting rooms?

feedback.naturalExpression: Is there any way we could switch to connecting rooms?
feedback.explanation: 先问是否有可能安排，适合需要对方查看余位或规则的请求，语气比直接要求更柔和。

choices.text: What about other floors?

feedback.assessment: 可以理解，但还可以更自然
feedback.naturalExpression: Are there connecting rooms available on another floor?
feedback.explanation: 这句在上下文清楚时很自然；如果要避免误会，可以补充仍在询问其他楼层的连通房。

choices.text: Other floor has connecting rooms?

feedback.naturalExpression: Are there connecting rooms available on another floor?
feedback.explanation: 可说“Are there connecting rooms on another floor?”；原句缺少完整疑问结构，单数“floor”也需要限定词。

turns.text: Yes. We have two connecting rooms available on the sixth floor.

turns.prompt: 你想核对连通房与原预订在房型或价格上的差别，会怎么说？

choices.text: Are they the same room type as the ones we booked?

feedback.naturalExpression: Are they the same room type as the ones we booked?
feedback.explanation: “room type”指房型，换房时可据此确认规格是否保持一致。

choices.text: Would there be any difference in price?

feedback.naturalExpression: Would there be any difference in price?
feedback.explanation: “difference in price”问的是价格差额，适合比较两个方案的费用。

choices.text: Are both rooms still double rooms?

feedback.naturalExpression: Are both rooms still double rooms?
feedback.explanation: “still”强调原来的状态目前没有改变，是跟进进度或确认安排时的关键信息。

choices.text: Do we need to pay extra to switch?

feedback.naturalExpression: Do we need to pay extra to switch?
feedback.explanation: “Do we need”问的是有没有必要或是否必须，帮助分清必做步骤与可选做法。

choices.text: The two rooms are same price?

feedback.assessment: 可以理解，但还可以更自然
feedback.naturalExpression: Are they the same room type as the ones we booked?
feedback.explanation: 比较价格应说“Are the two rooms the same price?”；这只核对价钱，不同时说明房型。

turns.text: They’re the same room type and there’s no extra charge.

turns.prompt: 你想确认选择连通房，会怎么说？

choices.text: Great. We’d like the connecting rooms, please.

feedback.naturalExpression: Great. We’d like the connecting rooms, please.
feedback.explanation: “would like”清楚表达需求，语气比直接说“want”更委婉，适合提出请求或表达偏好。

choices.text: Perfect. Could you move both reservations to those rooms?

feedback.naturalExpression: Perfect. Could you move both reservations to those rooms?
feedback.explanation: “Could you …?”把希望对方做的动作写进问句，是常见的委婉请求。

choices.text: That would be great. We’ll take them.

feedback.naturalExpression: That would be great. We’ll take them.
feedback.explanation: “would be great”把选择说成自己乐于接受的安排，比命令对方照办更柔和。

choices.text: Okay, please change our two rooms there.

feedback.assessment: 可以理解，但还可以更自然
feedback.naturalExpression: Great. We’d like the connecting rooms, please.
feedback.explanation: “change our rooms there”不清楚；直接确认要哪组连通房，前台就知道可以办理。

turns.text: Certainly. I’ll assign both rooms to you.

turns.prompt: 你想确认连通房的房卡如何配置，会怎么说？

choices.text: Will we get separate key cards for each room?

feedback.naturalExpression: Will we get separate key cards for each room?
feedback.explanation: 先确认后续安排能否实现，便于对方说明条件、时间或限制。

choices.text: Great. Could we have two key cards for each room?

feedback.naturalExpression: Great. Could we have two key cards for each room?
feedback.explanation: “Could I / we …?”礼貌提出自己的需求或征求许可；这里不是在说过去的能力。

choices.text: Perfect. Are both rooms ready now?

feedback.naturalExpression: Perfect. Are both rooms ready now?
feedback.explanation: 用疑问句核对刚谈到的状态或条件，给对方确认和更正的机会。

choices.text: Can both of us open the two rooms?

feedback.assessment: 可以理解，但还可以更自然
feedback.naturalExpression: Will we get separate key cards for each room?
feedback.explanation: 这句问两人能否打开两间房；当前要问的是每间房是否分别配房卡，重点应放在“separate key cards”。

turns.text: Yes. I’ll give you two key cards for each room. Both rooms are ready.

turns.prompt: 你想回应对方的帮助或安排，表达谢意，会怎么说？

choices.text: Perfect. Thank you for arranging that.

feedback.naturalExpression: Perfect. Thank you for arranging that.
feedback.explanation: 感谢后面说明具体原因，让对方知道哪项帮助对自己有用。
